# UI Vault — full catalog

> 175 entries from 12 sources. Generated by `npm run llms`.

## Sources

### React Bits — https://reactbits.dev
134 free MIT components across text animations, backgrounds, animations and interactive components, with TypeScript/JavaScript and Tailwind/CSS variants per component. Pro tier adds blocks and templates.
License: MIT. Install: npx jsrepo add react-bits/<Component>.
### Motion Primitives — https://motion-primitives.com
~35 minimalist motion components by ibelick, built entirely on Motion (motion.dev). Every component is a copy-paste primitive with a dedicated CLI. Pro adds 50+ premium components and sections.
License: MIT. Install: npx motion-primitives@latest add <name>.
### FancyComponents — https://fancycomponents.dev
~46 fun and weird components recreating effects from award-winning sites — letter swaps, gravity, elastic lines, gooey filters. Fully MIT and open source by danielpetho.
License: MIT. Install: pnpm dlx shadcn add @fancy/<component>.
### NumberFlow — https://number-flow.barvian.me
The animated number (odometer/digit-spin) component. Dependency-free custom element + Web Animations API, reduced-motion aware, SSR friendly. 7.7k GitHub stars.
License: MIT. Install: npm i @number-flow/react.
### Watermelon UI — https://watermelon.sh
Fully open-source shadcn-style library: components, animated micro-interactions, section blocks and 10+ complete dashboards. Free forever for personal and commercial use.
License: Free. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://registry.watermelon.sh/r/<name>.json.
### Aceternity UI — https://ui.aceternity.com
200+ production-ready components and blocks that "look expensive" — parallax heroes, beams, shaders, docks. Free tier covers ~100 components; premium adds 200+ blocks and full templates.
License: Freemium. Install: npx aceternity-ui@latest add <name>.
### 21st.dev — https://21st.dev
Huge community registry of React components, blocks and shadcn themes. Largest categories: Buttons (2,043), Forms (1,522), Heroes (1,152). Freemium: 2 component copies/day free.
License: Freemium. Install: npx @21st/cli add <component-url>.
### shadcnStudio — https://shadcnstudio.com
Massive shadcn/ui block library (Marketing UI, Dashboard & App, eCommerce, Bento, Datatable) plus themes, templates and a Figma kit. 67 free blocks; Pro is $249 lifetime.
License: Freemium. Install: n/a.
### UI Layouts Pro — https://pro.ui-layouts.com
Complete page-level layouts (26+ hero variants, features, testimonials, pricing) viewable as shadcn, Tailwind or Motion variants, plus a drag-and-drop template builder. $139 one-time.
License: Paid. Install: n/a.
### Cue — https://cuedesign.space
92 hand-curated components sourced from Sites of the Day. Each ships an AI prompt you paste into Bolt, v0, Cursor or Claude. React source code rolling out; Cue+ is $99 lifetime.
License: Freemium. Install: n/a.
### CollectUI — https://collectui.com
Visual inspiration gallery of Dribbble-style designs organized into 147 categories (Dashboard, Sign Up, Pricing, Music Player, Dynamic Island…). Pure pattern recognition fuel.
License: Free. Install: n/a.
### The Component Gallery — https://component.gallery
Reference of 60 component patterns, each aggregating real screenshots from design systems (Polaris, Elastic EUI, Ariakit, HeroUI…) with links to docs, GitHub and Figma.
License: Free. Install: n/a.

## All entries by category

### Text & Typography (text-animation)
- **SplitText** https://reactbits.dev/text-animations/split-text — Splits text into words or lines and reveals them with a smooth staggered animation as they enter the viewport. [MIT, live-previewable, category: text-animation]
- **BlurText** https://reactbits.dev/text-animations/blur-text — Words blur in one by one when they scroll into view. A subtle, premium reading reveal for headings. [MIT, live-previewable, category: text-animation]
- **GlitchText** https://reactbits.dev/text-animations/glitch-text — RGB-split glitch effect for text — cyberpunk energy without the noise. [MIT, live-previewable, category: text-animation]
- **DecryptedText** https://reactbits.dev/text-animations/decrypted-text — Scrambles through random characters before settling on the real text — the classic "hacker decode" reveal. [MIT, live-previewable, category: text-animation]
- **GradientText** https://reactbits.dev/text-animations/gradient-text — Text filled with an animated gradient. Cheap trick, expensive look. [MIT, live-previewable, category: text-animation]
- **CircularText** https://reactbits.dev/text-animations/circular-text — Text on a rotating circular SVG path — great for badges, stamps and corner flourishes. [MIT, live-previewable, category: text-animation]
- **ShinyText** https://reactbits.dev/text-animations/shiny-text — A light sweep travels across bold text — the signature accent on premium hero headlines. [MIT, live-previewable, category: text-animation]
- **TextEffect** https://motion-primitives.com/docs/text-effect — Per-character text animation with blur, slide and fade presets — the workhorse reveal primitive. [MIT, live-previewable, category: text-animation]
- **Text Scramble** https://motion-primitives.com/docs/text-scramble — Characters shuffle through random glyphs before locking into place. [MIT, live-previewable, category: text-animation]
- **Text Morph** https://motion-primitives.com/docs/text-morph — Morphs one word into another, interpolating letters smoothly. [MIT, live-previewable, category: text-animation]
- **Text Roll** https://motion-primitives.com/docs/text-roll — Rolling column of words that cycles with a vertical roll transition. [MIT, live-previewable, category: text-animation]
- **Shimmer Wave** https://motion-primitives.com/docs/shimmer-wave — A shimmer sweep travels across the text in a wave — premium loading or heading accent. [MIT, live-previewable, category: text-animation]
- **Letter Swap** https://fancycomponents.dev/docs/letter-swap — On hover, letters scramble through glyphs and settle one by one — playful link/button treatment. [MIT, live-previewable, category: text-animation]
- **Scramble Hover** https://fancycomponents.dev/docs/scramble-hover — Whole word scrambles and re-decodes when hovered — the decrypt effect on demand. [MIT, live-previewable, category: text-animation]
- **Text Highlighter** https://fancycomponents.dev/docs/text-highlighter — Marker-pen highlight sweeps across text as you scroll — hand-drawn emphasis. [MIT, live-previewable, category: text-animation]
- **Typewriter** https://fancycomponents.dev/docs/typewriter — Types and deletes text with a blinking caret and loop — the dependable typewriter. [MIT, live-previewable, category: text-animation]
- **Text Generate Effect** https://ui.aceternity.com/components/text-generate-effect — Words materialize from blur one by one — the classic AI-reveal heading. [MIT, live-previewable, category: text-animation]
- **Texts — Community Gallery** https://21st.dev/community/components/texts — 663 text effect components — animations for every typographic mood. [Freemium, link-out only, category: text-animation]
- **Mesh-Warped Typewriter Engine** https://cuedesign.space — Typewriter text that warps through a mesh as it types — typography as a material. [Freemium, link-out only, category: text-animation]
- **Cryptic Decoder Reveal** https://cuedesign.space — Headline decodes from cryptic glyphs — spy-movie title sequence energy. [Freemium, link-out only, category: text-animation]
